data.source_title: About the Department of Emergency Medicine: Clerkship Overview
data.locator: Clerkship Overview; clinical services and Rapid Decision Unit sections
data.source_setting: Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School Emergency Medicine clerkship and Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital (RWJUH), New Brunswick, NJ; affiliated rotation sites also include Somerset and Monmouth.
data.source_period: Current public program description accessed 2026-10-10; no training year or cohort dates given.
data.source_n: No learner cohort denominator reported. Page currently describes adult ED volume as over 80,000 visits annually; another page section says approximately 95,000, so neither should be treated as a reconciled current count.
value: Rapid Decision Unit for extended evaluation, treatment, monitoring, and disposition planning
data.source_evidence_basis: Official Rutgers RWJMS page lists clerkship length, supervision, simulation formats, rotation sites, and RDU workflow purpose.
data.limitations: This is a public description of emergency-medicine education and service pathways, not an EHR-specific curriculum, task-level RWJBH/Epic workflow specification, or measured efficacy study. Public page contains differing annual-volume statements in separate sections; neither figure is used as a calibrated denominator here.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Potential local context for case design around supervised ED care and observation/disposition, subject to clinician/faculty confirmation. Do not infer local staffing, Epic configuration, exact triage pathway, timing, or competency outcomes from this page.
